name: dialogue_letterbox_height_confirmed_003
reference: https://github.com/J0-o/KotorUniResPatch ("Scaled Letterbox") — independently re-verified against our own executable before use
root_cause: Vanilla derives the dialogue letterbox bar height from screen WIDTH: barHeight = round((screenHeight - round(screenWidth * scale)) * 0.5), using aspect-scalar floats at 0x00755788 (and 0x00755AE4 for one call site). At ultrawide, screenWidth*scale approaches/exceeds screenHeight, producing an undersized bar independent of any font-scale patch.
formula: barHeight = round(screenHeight / 6), computed as (field + 3) / 6 via signed integer division (add-half-divisor rounding)

hooks.name: Dialogue owner constructor bottom root placement
hooks.note: uses aspect scalar at 0x00755AE4 instead of 0x00755788 in the original code

hooks.name: CSWGuiDialog::SetRect LB_REPLIES height
hooks.note: Sizes the reply-choice listbox to rootHeight - repliesLocalTop so the listbox viewport, scrollbar, and clickable rows match the scaled letterbox.

hooks.name: CSWGuiDialogCinematic::SetReplies
hooks.note: Has an internal conditional branch using a push-address;ret idiom to reach 0x006A8E75 (a DIFFERENT address than the trampoline's own resume_va) for one of its two paths — this replicates the original 'test bit; je 0x006A8E75' logic exactly. Both destinations were manually traced and confirmed correct; do not simplify this stub without re-deriving the branch.

hooks.name: CSWGuiDialogCinematic old-height baseline
hooks.note: Forces the previous-dialog-root-height baseline to a literal 100 (0x64) before subtracting it from the new message height, instead of reading a stale value left over from a prior reply-box height expansion.

new_section.name: .klb
new_section.note: code|execute|read, read-only — no mutable state needed for this patch, unlike .kfs

excluded_changes: font scale / list-row height (separate patch, see confirmed_font_scale_patch.json)

validation.method: manual playtest screenshots at 3440x1440 across multiple dialogue scenes
validation.confirmed: dialogue subtitle text and the numbered reply-choice list both render without bottom-clipping; no further intermittent non-display reports after this candidate
